# Plugsmith

> Turn any repository into a Claude Code plugin and marketplace: plugsmith writes .claude-plugin/plugin.json and a one-plugin marketplace.json, checks them the way claude plugin validate does, and can prove them in a clean E2B microVM.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what plugsmith does, every tool and how to call it, what not to do
- [README.md](README.md): quick start, how it works, the rules it follows
- [identity/SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): who plugsmith is, what it owns, its boundaries

## Skills

- [skills/build-plugin/SKILL.md](skills/build-plugin/SKILL.md): turn a repo into a plugin with a one-plugin marketplace
- [skills/validate-plugin/SKILL.md](skills/validate-plugin/SKILL.md): check plugin.json and marketplace.json, with Claude Code's verdict and a clean room
- [skills/plugin-doctor/SKILL.md](skills/plugin-doctor/SKILL.md): diagnose a plugin that does not load or loads only partly

## MCP tools

- [src/mcp-server.ts](src/mcp-server.ts): `plugsmith-mcp` with `build_plugin`, `validate_plugin` and `validate_manifest`

## Code

- [src/builder.ts](src/builder.ts): the scanner and emitter
- [src/claude.ts](src/claude.ts): plugin.json and marketplace.json in Claude Code's shape, and the name rules
- [src/validate.ts](src/validate.ts): the check
- [src/sandbox.ts](src/sandbox.ts): the E2B clean room
- [evals/golden.json](evals/golden.json): golden cases, each matched against claude plugin validate

## Optional

- [identity/MEMORY.md](identity/MEMORY.md): what Claude Code reads in a plugin
- [identity/LEARNINGS.md](identity/LEARNINGS.md): corrections that became rules
- [dsip.json](dsip.json): the self-improvement contract
